test_name: Verify Navigation to Contact Us Page
description: This scenario tests the navigation link to the Contact Us page from the main menu and verifies its accessibility.
steps: Locate the 'CONTACT US' navigation link in the main menu using its stable selector and click on it.
Verify the browser redirects to https://atid.store/contact-us/.
Ensure the page title matches 'Contact Us'.
Verify the presence of the contact form on the page.
expected_results: The 'CONTACT US' link is clickable and functional.
The browser redirects to the correct URL (https://atid.store/contact-us/).
The Contact Us page loads successfully with all elements visible.
edge_cases: The 'CONTACT US' link is not visible on smaller screen sizes.
Clicking the link results in a 404 Page Not Found error.
Slow page load due to network or server issues.
The navigation link is disabled or unclickable.
Incorrect URL redirection due to misconfiguration.
data_requirements: Ensure the 'CONTACT US' link is visible and functional.
Confirm the Contact Us page URL is correctly configured.
Validate the presence of the contact form on the page.
Ensure no broken links or missing assets on the page.
Provide a test environment with stable network connectivity.
dependencies: The main menu must be fully loaded on the homepage.
The 'CONTACT US' link must be configured correctly.
The Contact Us page must be accessible.
The contact form must be present on the page.
All required assets must be loaded properly on the Contact Us page.
api_interactions: No direct API interactions; verify that navigation does not interfere with existing API calls.
performance_metrics: Measure page load time for the Contact Us page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'CONTACT US' link is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify the link has an appropriate ARIA role and label.
Check color contrast ratios for the navigation menu items.
Ensure the Contact Us page is accessible for screen readers.
Test navigation behavior with high contrast mode enabled.
